purpose: Ten answer-level scenarios (plan→blocker→resolution, correction, goal change, preference change, two true statements from different times, current vs previous truth, unanswerable, outdated fact beside its resolution, several related facts of which few are relevant, uncertainty vs contradiction). `required`/`forbidden` are for a model judge (eval/lift/liftCore.mjs); the deterministic labels are in answer-intelligence-labels.dev.v1.json.
